results.title: JDT’s world record reign highlights reliance on imported talent
results.description: PETALING JAYA: Johor Darul Ta'zim's Charity Shield triumph on Friday helped them set a new world record but also highlighted the club's growing reliance on mixed heritage and naturalised talent.

results.title: Forreston beats Dwight 42-12: Sauk Valley Week 1 football roundup
results.description: Forreston beat Dwight 42-12 as Connor Politsch had three TDs. Erie-Prophetstown beat Monmouth-Roseville 24-22, while Milledgeville, Polo, Amboy, West Carroll and Eastland-Pearl City also picked up wins on Friday.
